title: Python: the 6d constructed arm skips instanceClassOf, plus the round-2 fixture gaps N1-N5 (DEC-303 (a94) round-2 review)
description: Ordinary no-hold follow-up filed from the round-2 reviewer's non-blocking findings on opum-ai/glyph-cli#262 (GCLI-151), as ruled on the #262 landing (ODOC-640, opum-ai/opum-doc#2113): N1-N4 only. N5 was first carried by GCLI-169; DEC-303 (a95) item 2 ruled it OUT of opum-ai/glyph-cli#264 and it does NOT ride GCLI-169. DEC-303 (a96) item 2 keeps it here as fixtures that pin current behaviour plus a stated limit unless a fix is ruled first. DEC-303 (a96) item 1 adds a star-import measurement: a wildcard that rebinds a name already bound by a named import is not modelled, in this repository or on dev, and how often that shape occurs on the five pins is measured here. N1: the annotated-assign arm (x: C = ...) has no fixture. N2: the !mro.ok fail-closed at calls.ts ~4566 refuses x: C -> x.m() whenever a descendant's MRO fails even with no write, and no fixture covers it. N3: the setattr(self, __class__, X) fixture pins write recording through the own-MRO guard, not a red-before fixture. N4: the R4 local pin is really the 6d single-binding arm; multi-binding R4 has no resolving pin. Scope each before building; any analyzer change is removal-only with a fixture and a mutant per path. GCLI-172 stays without a hold and cannot close while either criterion added by (a96) is unchecked.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of N1-N4 is scoped with a measured dev outcome and either a fixture or a stated reason it is not a fixture
Any analyzer change is removal-only, with a fixture and a mutant observed red per path, and removal-only proved by the subset check with flags

N5: the #264 measurement (write shape, no-write twin, no-__new__ controls) is kept as fixtures that pin current behaviour, and N5 stays a stated limit unless a fix is ruled first; any N5 fix proposal comes to opum-doc before it is built, names how the refusal is keyed, and shows that every corpus removal is a wrong edge
The star-import shape from (a96) item 1 is measured on the five pins: how often two named imports bind a name and a trailing from .other import * rebinds it through __all__ (measurement only, no fix)

implementationNotes: N5 measured evidence, carried from GCLI-169/#264 by DEC-303 (a95). Read-only on dev d0ea6bc4, one file, three twins: (1) write shape — class C with __new__ returning D(), class D(C) whose __init__ writes self.__class__ = Other, x = C(); x.m() resolves to app.py:C.m (a real wrong edge); (2) no-write twin — same __new__, D.__init__ pass, resolves to C.m; (3) no-__new__ controls, with and without the write, resolve to C.m. The candidate fix built in #264 made knownClassOf's call arm consult instanceClassOf; (a95) removed it from that PR because it also refused the no-write twin and removed 129 five-pin edges (flask 1, httpx 23, jinja 20, rich 48, tqdm 37) not shown wrong, and ruled N5 a stated limit in the pre-registration plus an item on this task. How a later fix keys its refusal is this task's design question and comes to opum-doc; no design is recorded here.

DEC-303 (a96) item 2 applied to this task's record: the description no longer says N5 rides GCLI-169 (a95 item 2 ruled it out of #264) and acceptance criteria 3 and 4 were added — N5's #264 measurement kept as fixtures pinning current behaviour with N5 a stated limit unless a fix is ruled first and any fix proposal routed to opum-doc first, and the (a96) item 1 star-import measurement on the five pins. The task stays without a hold and cannot close while either added criterion is unchecked. No fix for either shape is built.
